event.label: Last listed in the directories transcribed so far (1915)

body.p: Bouverie Place is a lane off the west side of Bouverie Street, near its south end. In 1879 the directory lists the turn into Bouverie Place just before Alma Street.
It is first listed in the directories in 1879 and last in 1915. It had at most five listings, all of them houses.

div.head: Along the street
div.p: In the Bouverie Street listings the turn comes between Nos 11 and 13 in 1879, and between Nos 19 and 21 in 1900.

div.head: Records
div.p: Every directory and electoral-roll listing for Bouverie Place can be browsed in search. Each directory year links to its own page from Sands & McDougall Directories.
